name: @appydave/appyrig
description: Live view of agent teams across machines

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently --kill-others -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && NODE_ENV=production npm run build -w client && npm run build -w collector
scripts.test: npm run test -w server -w client -w collector && npm run test:root
scripts.stylelint:ratchet: npm run stylelint && npm run stylelint:baseline && git diff --exit-code -- stylelint-suppressions.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w server -w client -w collector && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.arch:check: depcruise shared/src server/src server/scripts client/src collector/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json && node scripts/arch-strings.mjs
scripts.arch:folders: depcruise shared/src server/src client/src collector/src --config .dependency-cruiser-folders.cjs --output-type baseline | prettier --stdin-filepath known.json | git diff --no-index --exit-code .dependency-cruiser-known-folder-cycles.json - || (echo 'FOLDER CYCLES CHANGED. Lines starting with + are new folder cycles: fix them (see the rule comment in .dependency-cruiser-folders.cjs). Lines starting with - are cycles you removed: record that with npm run arch:baseline.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:duplicates: npm run lint:duplicates:fast && npm run lint:duplicates:semantic
scripts.lint:duplicates:fast: npm run lint:duplicates:exact && npm run lint:duplicates:identifiers && npm run lint:duplicates:renamed && npm run lint:duplicates:similar
scripts.lint:duplicates:semantic: jscpd --config .jscpd.json --kind semantic --semantic --semantic-download CodeRankEmbed --semantic-model CodeRankEmbed --semantic-scope all --semantic-same-threshold 0.90 --semantic-threshold 0.90 --min-tokens 50 --min-lines 1 --baseline .jscpd/semantic.json --fail-on-new-clones 0 --report-name semantic

author: David Cruwys
